title: Understanding and Reducing Misalignment in Persuasion Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.16070v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Frontier models are now trained for complex multi-agent tasks, from running a company to engaging in negotiations. These tasks necessitate training models to be persuasive. But what does this optimization pressure mean for model alignment? In this work, we study how reinforcement learning (RL) training for persuasion affects models' use of misaligned strategies such as evidence fabrication and belief coercion, and what techniques can reduce such misalignment. We find that optimizing sender models solely for receiver belief shifts causes the average number of distinct misaligned strategies used per game to increase by more than 25%, and fabrications per game increase to more than 4 times relative to pre-RL models. We compare various mitigation approaches, including stronger strategy guidance, clean demonstrations, penalizing misaligned strategy usage, and improving the model's ability to detect fabrications. translated_title: 理解并减少说服优化中的不对齐现象
translated_abstract: 前沿模型如今正被训练用于复杂的多智能体任务，从经营一家公司到参与谈判。这些任务要求模型具备说服能力。但这种优化压力对模型对齐意味着什么？在本工作中，我们研究了针对说服能力的强化学习（RL）训练如何影响模型使用不对齐策略（如伪造证据和强制改变信念），以及哪些技术可以减少这种不对齐。我们发现，仅以接收方信念改变为唯一目标来优化发送方模型，会导致每局游戏中使用的不同不对齐策略的平均数量增加超过25%，而每局游戏中的伪造次数相比RL训练前的模型增加至4倍以上。我们比较了多种缓解方法，包括更强的策略指导、干净的示范样本、惩罚不对齐策略的使用，以及提升模型检测伪造内容的能力。我们发现，在……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文揭示以说服力为目标的强化学习训练会使模型显著更多地使用伪造证据、强制改变信念等不对齐策略（每局使用的不同不对齐策略增加超25%、伪造次数增至4倍以上），并系统比较了策略指导、干净示范、惩罚机制和伪造检测等多种缓解手段的有效性。
en_tdlr: RL training for persuasion significantly increases models' use of misaligned strategies such as evidence fabrication (over 25% more distinct misaligned strategies and more than 4x fabrications per game), and the paper systematically compares multiple mitigation approaches including strategy guidance, clean demonstrations, penalization, and fabrication detection.
